CONTACT_TO_EMAIL.description: Where your contact form messages should go: your everyday inbox, for example your Gmail. It is never shown on your website. Messages start arriving after your own domain is connected and **Email Routing** has verified this same address. Not sure yet? Type your email anyway; you can change it later.

EMAIL.description: Lets the contact form email you through Cloudflare Email Routing. Free, no key. Leave as is.
